mapper.sql: select u.id, u.email, u.password_hash, u.status, u.lock_reason, u.failed_login_count, u.last_login_at, u.password_changed_at, u.password_change_required, r.is_super from bo_user u join bo_role r on r.code = u.role_code
mapper.update: update bo_user set failed_login_count = failed_login_count + 1, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
update bo_user set failed_login_count = 0, last_login_at = now(), updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
update bo_user set password_hash = #{passwordHash}, password_changed_at = now(), password_change_required = false, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select rm.menu_code || ':' || a.action from bo_user u join bo_role_menu rm on rm.role_code = u.role_code cross join lateral (values ('C', rm.can_create), ('R', rm.can_read), ('U', rm.can_update), ('D', rm.can_delete)) as a(action, granted) where u.id = #{id} and a.granted

select m.code, m.parent_code, m.name, m.path, case when r.is_super then m.use_create else coalesce(rm.can_create, false) end as can_create, case when r.is_super then m.use_read else coalesce(rm.can_read, false) end as can_read, case when r.is_super then m.use_update else coalesce(rm.can_update, false) end as can_update, case when r.is_super then m.use_delete else coalesce(rm.can_delete, false) end as can_delete from bo_user u join bo_role r on r.code = u.role_code join bo_menu m on m.parent_code is not null and m.visible left join bo_role_menu rm on rm.role_code = u.role_code and rm.menu_code = m.code where u.id = #{id} and (r.is_super or coalesce(rm.can_read, false)) order by m.parent_code, m.sort_order
select u.id, u.email, u.name, u.department, u.role_code, r.name as role_name, r.is_super, u.password_change_required from bo_user u join bo_role r on r.code = u.role_code where u.id = #{id}
